title: ServiceMetricsContract
description: The metric catalog a service serves from GET /contracts. Produced by telemetry and digital-twin, merged by dashboard, rendered by the frontend (TypeScript), which cannot share the Rust type. Every field is one word, so the Rust name is the wire name.

kind.description: Metric id in snake_case, e.g. 'people_count'. A reading's 'type' carries the same id.

unit.description: Null, not absent, when a metric is unitless -- serde skips nothing here.

actions.description: Optional when parsing: a source may omit it and the crate defaults to empty.

aggregation.description: How a building's figure is made from its rooms' readings: their mean or their total. Absent on a room attribute (a name, a capacity), which has no building figure.

source.description: Absent from a producer's own response; dashboard backfills it with the service name.

limit.description: The ends a metric's limit has. A present end can be set; its number is where a new building starts, null when there is none. An absent end cannot be set; {} means no limit at all. Optional when parsing.

fieldKind.description: The Debug rendering of telemetry's FieldKind. Renaming a variant changes this wire value with no compile error, which is why it is enumerated here.
